status_history_status_check.name: status_history_status_check
status_history_status_check.value: ("status_history"."scale" = 'report' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('todo', 'in_progress', 'submitted', 'waiting', 'confirmed', 'needs_fix', 'not_required') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('todo', 'in_progress', 'submitted', 'waiting', 'confirmed', 'needs_fix', 'not_required'))) or ("status_history"."scale" = 'payment' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('unpaid', 'partial', 'paid', 'not_required') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('unpaid', 'partial', 'paid', 'not_required'))) or ("status_history"."scale" = 'task' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('todo', 'in_progress', 'rework', 'on_confirm', 'confirmed', 'done', 'failed', 'cancelled') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('todo', 'in_progress', 'rework', 'on_confirm', 'confirmed', 'done', 'failed', 'cancelled'))) or ("status_history"."scale" = 'service' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('active', 'paused', 'archived') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('active', 'paused', 'archived'))) or ("status_history"."scale" = 'project' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('planned', 'in_progress', 'done', 'cancelled') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('planned', 'in_progress', 'done', 'cancelled'))) or ("status_history"."scale" = 'indicator' and "status_history"."to_status" in ('empty', 'filled', 'checked') and ("status_history"."from_status" is null or "status_history"."from_status" in ('empty', 'filled', 'checked')))

status_history_rollback_reason_check.name: status_history_rollback_reason_check
status_history_rollback_reason_check.value: not "status_history"."is_rollback" or ("status_history"."from_status" is not null and "status_history"."reason" is not null and btrim("status_history"."reason") <> '')

report_types_rule_check.name: report_types_rule_check
report_types_rule_check.value:
"report_types"."due_day" >= 1 and ("report_types"."due_after" is null or "report_types"."due_after" between 0 and 12)
        and ("report_types"."due_month" is null or "report_types"."due_month" between 1 and 12)
        and ("report_types"."pay_day" is null or "report_types"."pay_day" between 1 and 31)
        and ("report_types"."pay_after" is null or "report_types"."pay_after" between 0 and 12)
        and ("report_types"."pay_month" is null or "report_types"."pay_month" between 1 and 12)
        and "report_types"."skip_quarters" <@ array[1, 2, 3, 4]::smallint[]

tax_benefit_due_rules_rule_check.name: tax_benefit_due_rules_rule_check
tax_benefit_due_rules_rule_check.value:
("tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_day" is null or "tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_day" between 1 and 31)
        and ("tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_after" is null or "tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_after" between 0 and 12)
        and ("tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_month" is null or "tax_benefit_due_rules"."due_month" between 1 and 12)
        and ("tax_benefit_due_rules"."pay_day" is null or "tax_benefit_due_rules"."pay_day" between 1 and 31)
        and ("tax_benefit_due_rules"."pay_after" is null or "tax_benefit_due_rules"."pay_after" between 0 and 12)
